rules.included: EnemyCollisionModel entries of the root owner's (PawnEnemy subclass) _collisions, in list order; BulletBlockModel / InGameWallCollisionModel / other HybridCollisionModel classes excluded
rules.Capsule: _points = half extents (x, y->z); circles of r = short along the long axis, centres evenly from -(long-short) to +(long-short), gaps = ceil(span / (1.5*short)); equal extents -> one circle
rules.Box/BoxNR: centres as capsule, r = sqrt(short^2 + (gap/2)^2); square -> one equal-area circle r = 2a/sqrt(pi)
rules.Polygon: bbox aspect <= 2: one circle at the vertex mean, r = 0.8 * farthest vertex (Md01); else slices along the long axis (count as box rule), each covered by its own circle (extrapolated)
rules.transform: position = Unity TRS composition of the chain below the prefab root, Y dropped; extents x lossy scale (x, z); shape turned by the projected yaw of its node (the reference ignored it)
